name: Valid passport or national ID card
nameEs: Pasaporte o documento nacional de identidad
whatToBring: A passport or national ID card that is valid and in force

name: Employer's hiring declaration or employment certificate
nameEs: Declaración de contratación o certificado de empleo
whatToBring: A hiring declaration from the employer or an employment certificate
Also accepted: the employment contract registered with the public employment service, or your Social Security registration

name: Health insurance that covers you in Spain
office: An insurer, or your pension country
whatToBring: Public or private health insurance, taken out in Spain or abroad, with cover in Spain equivalent to the national health system
Pensioners: a certificate showing the right to health care paid by the country that pays the pension

name: Proof of sufficient resources
whatToBring: Any legally accepted proof, for example property titles, certified cheques, proof of capital income, or credit cards with an up-to-date bank certificate of the available credit
Assessed individually, taking your personal and family situation into account

name: Appointment at the foreigners' office
whatToBring: The appointment must be requested by the foreign citizen or an authorised representative
unverifiedReason: The booking app (icp.administracionelectronica.gob.es) could not be read, so it is not confirmed which procedure to pick for Málaga or whether the appointment is mandatory.

name: NIE number on its own (form EX-15)
office: Oficina de Extranjería or Comisaría de Policía; from abroad: a Spanish consulate
whatToBring: Form EX-15
Proof of payment of fee Modelo 790 Código 012
The reasons why you need the number

name: EU citizen registration certificate (includes your NIE)
nameEs: Certificado de registro de ciudadano de la Unión
office: Oficina de Extranjería of the province, or else the Comisaría de Policía
whatToBring: Form EX-18
Proof of payment of fee Modelo 790 Código 012
Valid passport or national ID card
The documents for your situation (worker, self-employed, or own means), original and copy
Apply in person within three months of entering Spain; the certificate is issued immediately

name: Proof of where you live (e.g. rental contract)
office: Your landlord, owner or utility company
whatToBring: One of: title deed (escritura, nota del registro, IBI receipt); a utility contract (electricity, water or gas) with a recent bill if not current; a current rental contract with the last rent receipt
With a private rental contract: a photocopy of the landlord's ID
Or: authorisation from a person already registered there, with their proof of ownership or rental and a copy of their ID

name: Register at the town hall (padrón)
office: Edificio de Tabacalera or a Junta Municipal de Distrito, Málaga
whatToBring: Hoja padronal, filled in and signed
EU citizens: passport or ID document from your country, with the EU registration certificate (NIE) if you have one
Proof of where you live
No fee

name: Register with the tax office as self-employed (modelo 036)
office: Agencia Tributaria, online (certificate or Cl@ve) or at the office for your tax address
whatToBring: Modelo 036
Your NIF, which for foreigners is normally your NIE
File before starting the activity

name: Social Security number
whatToBring: Your identity data (DNI or NIE)
Mobile phone, email and usual address
Without electronic ID: a selfie and a photo of your document

name: Spanish bank account
unverifiedReason: Banks are private; no official source says what they require. Included because the RETA registration asks for a bank account for direct debit.

name: Register as self-employed with Social Security (RETA)
whatToBring: Your IAE and CNAE activity codes
Start date and address of the activity
Estimated yearly net income, contribution base, mutua
A bank account for direct debit
Apply before you start (up to 60 days ahead)

name: Your employer registers you with Social Security
nameEs: Alta en la Seguridad Social por la empresa
whatToBring: Your Social Security number
unverifiedReason: The employer-side Seguridad Social page was not read. The NUSS page only says you need the number to be registered for the first time when you start working.
